passages.text: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David spoke to the LORD.
David spoke words of a song.
David sang this song on a special day.
On that day, the LORD saved David.
The LORD saved David from all his enemies.
The LORD also saved David from Saul.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־ אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the LORD.
David said these words after God saved him from all his enemies and from Saul.
David said, “The LORD is my rock.
The LORD is my fortress.
The LORD is my deliverer.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the LORD.
David said these words after the LORD saved him from all his enemies and from Saul.
David said, "My God is my rock.
I take refuge in Him.
He is my shield.
He is the horn of my salvation.
He is my stronghold.
He is my refuge.
He is my Savior.
You save me from violence."
passages.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־ בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
passages.sermon: The LORD is worthy of praise.\r\nI will call upon the LORD.\r\nThe LORD will save me from my enemies.
passages.original: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃

passages.text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
passages.sermon: The waves of death surrounded me.\r\nThe torrents of chaos frightened me.
passages.original: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־ מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃

passages.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
passages.sermon:
Sheol is the place of the dead.
The cords of Sheol wrapped around me.
The snares of death stood before me.
Death tried to trap me.
passages.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי־ מָֽוֶת׃

passages.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.
passages.sermon:
I was in distress.
I called upon the LORD.
I cried out to my God.
He heard my voice from His temple.
My cry for help reached His ears.
passages.original: בַּצַּר־ לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־ אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
passages.sermon:
God became very angry.
The earth shook.
The earth quaked.
The foundations of the heavens trembled.
The foundations of the heavens shook.
God’s anger caused all these things.
passages.original: וַתִּגְעַשׁ וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־ חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
passages.sermon:
God responded with power and anger.
Smoke rose from His nostrils.
Fire came from His mouth and consumed.
Glowing coals blazed out from Him.
passages.original: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God parted the heavens.
God came down to the earth.
Dark clouds lay beneath God's feet.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful and glorious.
He mounted a cherub.
He flew.
He soared on the wings of the wind.
passages.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל־ כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל־ כַּנְפֵי־ רֽוּחַ׃

passages.text: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.
passages.sermon:
God acted with great power.
God surrounded Himself with darkness.
He made darkness like a shelter around Himself.
He gathered water around Him.
He placed thick clouds near Him.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־ מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃

passages.text: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.
passages.sermon:
God is present.
His presence shines with great brightness.
Coals of fire blaze from this brightness.
The fire comes directly from God’s presence.
passages.original: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי־ אֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.
passages.sermon: The LORD is the Most High God.\r\nHe thundered from heaven.\r\nThe voice of the Most High sounded powerfully.
passages.original: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־ שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD fights for His people.
The LORD shot His arrows.
His arrows scattered His enemies.
The LORD hurled lightning.
His lightning confused and defeated His enemies.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק וַיְהֻמֵּם׃

passages.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is powerful.
He rebuked with great force.
The channels of the sea became visible.
The foundations of the world were uncovered.
This happened at the LORD’s rebuke.
This happened when the breath of His nostrils blasted out.
passages.original: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
passages.sermon:
God is powerful and cares for His people.
God is above all things.
God reached down from heaven.
God took hold of me.
God pulled me out of deep waters.
God saved me from great danger.
passages.original: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
passages.sermon:
God rescued me.
My enemy was powerful.
My foes were too strong for me.
God saved me from them.
passages.original: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
passages.sermon: My enemies confronted me on the day I faced disaster.\r\nThe LORD supported me.
passages.original: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃

passages.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
passages.sermon: God brought me out into a wide, open place.\r\nGod rescued me.\r\nGod did this because He delighted in me.
passages.original: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־ חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD rewarded me.
He looked at my righteousness.
He repaid me for the cleanness of my hands.
He gave me what I deserved because I did what was right.
He acted because I lived in a pure way.
passages.original: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃

passages.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
passages.sermon:
I have kept the ways of the LORD.
I have not turned away from my God.
I have not done evil against Him.
I have remained faithful to God.
passages.original: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃

passages.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
passages.sermon:
God gave His ordinances.
I keep all His ordinances before me.
God gave His statutes.
I do not disregard His statutes.
I remember and obey what God commands.
passages.original: כִּ֥י כָל־ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־ אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
passages.sermon: I have been blameless before God.\r\nI have kept myself from iniquity.
passages.original: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃

passages.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD has acted.
The LORD has repaid me.
He repaid me because of my righteousness.
He saw my cleanness.
He repaid me according to my cleanness in His sight.
passages.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃

passages.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless; to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
passages.sermon:
God responds to people according to their character.
God shows Himself faithful to faithful people.
God shows Himself blameless to blameless people.
God shows Himself pure to pure people.
God shows Himself shrewd to crooked people.
passages.original: עִם־ חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־ גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃ עִם־ נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל׃

passages.text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.
passages.sermon: The LORD saves afflicted people.\r\nThe LORD looks at proud people.\r\nThe LORD brings down the proud.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־ רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃

passages.text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.
passages.sermon: The LORD is my lamp.\r\nThe LORD gives me light.\r\nThe LORD removes my darkness.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃

passages.text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.
passages.sermon:
God gives me strength.
I trust in God.
With God, I can run against an army.
With my God, I can climb over a wall.
God helps me overcome great obstacles.
God makes me able to do what seems impossible.
passages.original: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־ שֽׁוּר׃

passages.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
passages.sermon:
God is perfect in all His ways.
The LORD always acts without fault.
The word of the LORD is flawless.
God protects people who trust Him.
He is a shield for everyone who takes refuge in Him.
passages.original: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the only true God.
No one else is God.
Our God alone is the Rock.
No one else is a Rock like Him.
passages.original: כִּ֥י מִי־ אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear.
passages.sermon:
God is my strong fortress.
God gives me strength.
God makes my way clear.
God guides me without error.
God protects me.
passages.original: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דַּרְכּוֹ׃

passages.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
passages.sermon:
God acts with strength and faithfulness.
God makes my feet swift and sure, like a deer.
God places me securely on high places.
God gives me stability and confidence in difficult places.
passages.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רַגְלָיו כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
passages.sermon:
God is my strong fortress.
God makes my way clear.
God trains my hands for battle.
My arms can bend a bow of bronze.
passages.original: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־ נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.
passages.sermon:
God gives me His shield.
This shield brings salvation.
God shows me gentleness.
His gentleness lifts me up.
passages.original: וַתִּתֶּן־ לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
passages.sermon:
God protects me.
God makes my path wide.
God places this wide path under my feet.
My steps are steady.
My ankles do not slip.
passages.original: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃

passages.text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
passages.sermon:
David speaks as a servant of God.
David had enemies.
I chased my enemies.
I destroyed my enemies.
I did not turn back.
I kept going until all my enemies were gone.
passages.original: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־ כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
passages.sermon:
David speaks as a victorious king and warrior.
God gives David victory over his enemies.
I destroyed my enemies.
I crushed them completely.
They could not get up again.
They fell down under my feet.
passages.original: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃

passages.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
passages.sermon:
God gave me strength.
God prepared me for battle.
God made my enemies fall.
God put my foes under me.
passages.original: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃

passages.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.
passages.sermon:
God gave me victory over my enemies.
My enemies turned their backs and ran from me.
God made those who hated me powerless.
I destroyed those who hated me.
passages.original: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃

passages.text: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.
passages.sermon:
The enemies looked for help.
No one saved them.
They called to the LORD.
The LORD did not answer them.
passages.original: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃

passages.text: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.
passages.sermon:
David speaks about his enemies.
He defeated his enemies completely.
He ground them down like dust on the earth.
He crushed them like mud in the streets.
He trampled them underfoot.
passages.original: וְאֶשְׁחָקֵ֖ם כַּעֲפַר־ אָ֑רֶץ כְּטִיט־ חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖ם אֶרְקָעֵֽם׃

passages.text: You have delivered me from the strife of my people; You have preserved me as the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
passages.sermon:
God delivered me from the conflict among my own people.
God kept me safe.
God made me the leader over many nations.
People I did not know now serve me.
passages.original: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־ יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃

passages.text: Foreigners cower before me; when they hear me, they obey me.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners see me.
They become afraid.
They cower before me.
They hear my voice.
They obey me.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־ לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃

passages.text: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
passages.sermon:
Foreigners see me.
They become afraid.
They lose courage.
They come out from their strong places.
They tremble as they come.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְיַחְגְּר֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may God, the Rock of my salvation, be exalted— the God who avenges me and brings down nations beneath me, who frees me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
passages.sermon:
The LORD lives.
The LORD is my Rock.
Blessed be my Rock.
God is the Rock of my salvation.
May God be exalted.
God avenges me.
God brings down nations beneath me.
God frees me from my enemies.
God lifts me above my foes.
God rescues me from violent men.
passages.original: חַי־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְיָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽי׃ הָאֵ֕ל הַנֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑י וּמוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃ וּמוֹצִיאִ֖י מֵאֹֽיְבָ֑י וּמִקָּמַי֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
passages.sermon:
David speaks these words.
David is the king of Israel.
David is the anointed one of God.
David says, “I will praise You, LORD.
I will praise You among the nations.
I will sing praises to Your name.”
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּלְשִׁמְךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר׃

passages.text: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.”
passages.sermon:
God brings great salvation to His king.
God shows loving devotion to His anointed one.
God shows loving devotion to David.
God shows loving devotion to David’s descendants forever.
passages.original: מַגְדִּיל יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑וֹ וְעֹֽשֶׂה־ חֶ֧סֶד לִמְשִׁיח֛וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃פ
